answer: Make every identity post a bond that only matures after a long, graded tenure - a jade seal earned slowly, not bought. A newcomer starts at the glacier edge: its answers are quarantined from payouts until peers have attested them across many epochs, so a farm of fresh clones earns nothing while it waits. Reputation then compounds upward toward a zenith of trust that one bad verdict can slash to zero, making each marginal clone costlier than the last.
